{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{For|other uses of [[XR (Disambiguation)|XR]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = XR700.png |image-dynamic = XR700Dynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Mecha Base]] |type = Vehicle (& Humanoid) |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]500 |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]8 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.15 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 4 |hidden = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''XR700''' was the third vehicle that spawned from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawned when the [[Mecha Base]] was at Level 3. As with other units, it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''XR700''' had a spawnrate of 45 seconds. '''XR700''' could attack enemies with its turret. ==Appearance== '''XR700''' was a blue tracked mech. It had tracks covered by armor. The operator could shoot from its turret. The operator itself had yellow skin, its torso and legs were black, and it wore white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''XR700''' can be quite useful against hordes of high health enemies like the [[Giant Boss]], [[Chained Boss]] or [[Slow Boss]]. **Due to its long range, it can easily attack enemies from a long distance. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''XR700''' will spawn per Level 3 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path in some maps, like [[Infernal Abyss]], but may always go down one specific path in other maps, like [[Badlands]]. *The '''XR700''' can deal full collision damage to shielded enemies, like the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Templar]]. **Even more interestingly, damage from its turrets is not capped, meaning that the '''XR700''' can operate at maximum DPS against these enemies. *As with other units, the firerate and range of '''XR700''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''XR700''' cannot be stunned by any enemy, making it very useful against such enemies. **It also makes it very useful against major bosses, like the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] or [[Gold Titan]]. *While '''XR700''' can collide with [[Hidden]]s and [[Ninja]]s, it cannot detect them. ==Trivia== *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''XR700''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''7 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.1a]] **'''XR700''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''XR700''' removed, replaced by [[Mark III]]. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Exclusive Content]]
